category.not_available: Not available or not set up

hint.stopped: A person or an operator stopped it. Not a failure.
hint.permissions: A permission, an approval or a site’s rules said no, or an approval expired.
hint.quotas: A rate limit, a plan’s usage limit, or the turn’s round, time or output limit.
hint.not_available: Something isn’t connected or set up: no model, a sign-in that ended, a computer that isn’t configured.
hint.model_provider: The model was unreachable, busy, refused the request or filtered its answer.
hint.external_service: A website or another outside service failed or timed out.
hint.invalid_input: The model sent arguments a tool couldn’t read, or asked for something that doesn’t exist.
hint.runtime_error: Our own code failed, timed out, or the server stopped mid-turn.
hint.unclassified: The rules can’t tell from the code alone (a generic error code).
